Callout.Name: Raid - Suspected Stash House
Callout.Message: Warrant to be executed at an address holding stolen goods.

Script.Line: The door is locked and it stays locked.
You have got paperwork? Slip it under the door.
Alright. Alright, I am opening it. Do not shoot.

Stages.Stage: Team is at the door. Entry on your word.
One of them has gone for the back door.
Property recovered and the address is secure.

Lines.Briefing: A signed warrant and a front door. Go in loud, go in together.
Lines.Approach: The warrant is signed. Nobody moves until the team is at the door.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
